# Victor Mono

OdySea ships the Regular, Italic, Bold, and Bold Italic OpenType faces from
Victor Mono version 1.561. The restrained four-face set covers the weights and
styles used by the shell without carrying unused display weights.

Upstream project: https://github.com/rubjo/victor-mono-font

Victor Mono is distributed under the SIL Open Font License, Version 1.1. The
complete license is included in `OFL.txt` beside the font files.
